title: MiniRep: Robust Reputation-Based Aggregation for Multi-Agent Debate
abstract: arXiv:2609.39297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into an open agentic ecosystem. To support trustworthy collaboration, industry initiatives increasingly assess agent reputation from past behavior and provide performance leaderboards. However, reputation derived from past performance may not reliably predict an agent's behavior on new tasks, particularly when malicious agents can adapt their behavior and influence other agents during collaboration.   We study reputation in multi-agent debate (MAD), where multiple agents answer the same query, debate to improve their answers, and aggregate them into a final output. We present MiniRep, a reputation-based aggregation system for MAD under malicious agents. translated_title: MiniRep：面向多智能体辩论的鲁棒声誉聚合机制
translated_abstract: 由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的自主智能体正迅速演变为一个开放的智能体生态系统。为了支持可信协作，业界举措越来越多地根据智能体的历史行为来评估其声誉，并提供性能排行榜。然而，基于过去表现得出的声誉可能无法可靠地预测智能体在新任务上的行为，尤其是当恶意智能体能够调整自身行为并在协作过程中影响其他智能体时。我们研究了多智能体辩论（Multi-Agent Debate, MAD）中的声誉问题——多个智能体回答同一查询，通过辩论改进各自的答案，并将这些答案聚合为最终输出。我们提出了 MiniRep，一个面向 MAD 的、在存在恶意智能体情况下仍能正常工作的基于声誉的聚合系统。为了将我们的威胁模型建立在已有研究基础之上，我们借鉴声誉系统攻击和软件测试变异算子，构建了一个攻击分类法，涵盖对声誉的策略性利用等……
tldr: 提出了 MiniRep——一个在存在恶意智能体时依然稳健的、基于声誉的多智能体辩论（MAD）答案聚合系统，并构建了借鉴声誉系统攻击与软件测试变异算子的攻击分类法来支撑其威胁模型。
en_tdlr: MiniRep is a robust reputation-based aggregation system for multi-agent debate (MAD) that maintains reliability under malicious agents, supported by an attack taxonomy grounded in reputation-system attacks and software-testing mutation operators.
